notes.title: “Justified by his deeds and not by faith alone”
notes.intro: James says a person is justified by what he does and not by faith alone, which seems to contrast with Paul.

views.label: James shows that real faith works
views.summary: Protestants read James as describing faith that is genuine because it produces works; Paul and James address different problems.
views.source: Formula of Concord, Epitome IV; Calvin, Commentary on James

views.label: Faith and works together in justification
views.summary: Catholics see James as confirming that justification includes faith working through love.

views.label: Faith and life cannot be separated
views.summary: Orthodox and Anabaptist Christians emphasise that true faith is lived out in obedience and love.
views.source: Confession of Faith in a Mennonite Perspective, Article 17

notes.common: All agree that true faith shows itself in love.
